name: Grid Invoke
description: grid_invoke: Start a new operation on this venue or the selected execution venue and return its Job snapshot without waiting for completion. The returned id belongs to that execution venue, not to a local wrapper. Retain the id, execution venue and authentication mode for the advertised Job tools. A successful submission does not imply successful execution: inspect status. Calling again starts new work. Requires local invoke permission on the selected operation reference. Local execution also checks your resource permissions; remote execution is authorized by the destination using the explicitly selected identity and grants. Local scope does not narrow a supplied remote credential.

operation.description: Exact operation reference from catalog metadata, configuration or the task: v/ops/<group>/<op>, o/<pin>, a/<hash>, a hex asset hash, or a DID URL. Resolve it on the execution venue. A DID URL selects where to fetch a definition, not where to execute it. Never derive a catalog path from a tool name.

input.description: Arguments matching the target operation's input schema; any JSON value. Inspect unfamiliar operations' metadata before invoking them. Passed unchanged, including strings that look like JSON.

venue.description: Execution venue HTTP(S) URL or routable DID. Omit to use this operation's default venue, normally the current venue. This input overrides any definition-level venue. Null is invalid. Retain the selected venue when following the returned Job.

authenticateAs.description: Remote identity: anonymous (default) sends no identity or grants; caller requires your identity credential addressed to the target venue, with no capabilities, plus any separate grants; venue is only for the venue itself. Use the same mode and credentials when following the Job. Local calls retain your caller context.

output.description: Snapshot of the invoked Job on the execution venue, possibly already terminal. Follow its id on that same venue using the same authentication mode. This is not the record of a local grid wrapper.

id.description: Job ID on this record's hosting venue.

status.description: PENDING is queued; STARTED is running. PAUSED may be resumed. INPUT_REQUIRED or AUTH_REQUIRED needs the requested input or credentials sent to this Job. COMPLETE has output; FAILED, CANCELLED and REJECTED are terminal. Inspect error and errorCode when present; do not automatically resubmit.

output.description: The operation's output when COMPLETE; any JSON value, including null. The output can itself be a handle returned by that operation.

error.description: Reported reason for failure, rejection or cancellation: a string when available, otherwise absent or null.

errorCode.description: Optional operation-defined error code, a string or null; status alone does not identify the cause.

created.description: Creation time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

updated.description: Last record update in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

progress.description: Latest progress, usually {message, data?}; may also be a string or operation-specific detail. Progress is not the final output.

delegation.description: Observations of remote work, when this Job delegates or waits on another Job.

remoteId.description: Destination Job ID, not a local Job ID. Use only with its known hosting venue.

remoteStatus.description: Last observed destination state; may differ from this Job's status.

notFollowed.description: Why observation stopped and what the caller can do. Does not establish failure of the destination work.

cancellation.description: Evidence from an attempted backend cancellation; may arrive after local cancellation. Missing evidence does not prove remote work stopped.

outcome.description: requested: sent, no confirmation; acknowledged: peer reported cancellation; finished: peer reported another terminal outcome; rejected: peer refused; unknown: no conclusive answer. None undoes prior side effects.
